messages:
tara: Heads up 1: enterprise renewals team needs a concise migration runway and a defensible pinning policy to present to legal. Can we finalize acceptance criteria this afternoon?
samir: Quick proposal: onboarding gates = compatibility smoke + perf bench + safety eval. Perf gate: p95 <= 600ms hosted baseline, p95 <= 320ms dedicated. Quality gate: no more than 1.5% drop on customer evaluation set.
becky: Sales also asked for a clear deprecation cadence. Customers want a guaranteed migration window and a fallback for pinned tenants. Suggest: 90-day preferred migration, 180-day max with paid extension.
nate: Ops note: fallback for pinned tenants is not free. If we promise fallback routing to older pinned versions, we need capacity reservations and a reserve billing line. Finance, can we offer a short-term concession?
finance: We can model a 90-day free fallback for early movers but require a reserve fee for extensions beyond 90 days. Need numbers from eng on cost delta.
samir: For benchmarks: propose 2k sample prompts; measure p50,p95, tokens/generated, top-1 score, hallucination rate. Run in canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated regression checks at each step.
becky: Also make the per-customer option explicit: customers can opt into a seeded benchmark run using their production prompt slice; if they do, they get a one-time migration credit on pin fees.
tara: Rollback criteria? We need deterministic triggers for automatic rollback vs. human escalation.
reliability-bot: Suggested thresholds loaded: soft alert if p95 > 1.5x baseline OR quality delta < -1.5%; hard rollback if p95 > 2x baseline OR quality delta < -2.5% OR error-rate spike > 3x. Soft alerts escalate to oncall within 10 minutes.
nate: Add operational windows: soft alerts get 15 minutes to self-correct; if sustained across 3 samples -> automated rollback. Also require an ops-runbook entry visible in catalog UI linking to contact rotation.
samir: For the catalog UI we should surface checkboxes for each onboarding step (compatibility, perf bench link, eval snapshot, pin contract, telemetry dashboard, rollback policy). Make them mandatory for catalog publish.
becky: Exception flow for strategic customers: allow "extended pin TTL" with finance-approved reserve and a sunset commitment in the contract. Keep exceptions gated by Product + Finance + Sales.
ate: Canary automation ask: can we have the preflight post a formatted summary into the thread with a link to the raw results? reliability-bot: yes, preflight job scheduled and will post results.
reliability-bot: preflight finished: p50 110ms, p95 410ms, quality delta -0.8% vs baseline, hallucination delta +0.1%. No safety flags. Link: https://ci.internal/preflight/1729500000
tara: Those numbers are inside gates. Mark eligible for 10% rollout. Samir, can you draft the fallback routing rule?
samir: Drafting: if p95 > 700ms OR quality delta <= -2.0% -> auto-route pinned tenants to last-stable-pin and trigger incident workflow. Will add KV cache compatibility check before switch.
finance: For pricing, propose three tiers: self-serve pins (short TTL, higher per-token), enterprise pinned SLA (90-day included fallback, monthly reserved fee), long-term pin extension (custom pricing + reserve). Becky please incorporate into the renewal playbook.
becky: Will do. Also adding a migration incentive: 60% off pin fee for customers who migrate within 30 days of general availability + one free seeded benchmark run.
tara: Action items: Samir to publish tech appendix w/bench harness and rollback rules by EOD; Becky to update renewal playbook + pricing; Nate to add ops runbook + contact rotation; Finance to finalise reserve pricing.
samir: I'll also add a short section for product: "How pinning affects routing & cost" for the public doc.
tara: Goal: publish a 1-page migration runway doc for Sales by 10am PT tomorrow. If everyone OK, I'll loop in Legal then.
becky: ack.
finance: ack.
nate: ack.
reliability-bot: scheduled reminder to ping Legal at 09:00 PT tomorrow. :alarm_clock:
